This video presents excerpts from public interviews with an insider (John Perkins) who describes his experience working within international financial and political systems. He explains how large-scale economic decisions are made, how influence is exercised, and how certain patterns repeat across different countries.

The material focuses on the mechanisms behind major development projects, debt structures, and the relationships between governments, corporations, and financial institutions.

Viewers are encouraged to explore the original sources and form their own conclusions.
